note: EXPECTED-RED: nothing implements provider_raw_payloads or the TTL sweep yet (handback intake/2026-09-20-handback-corpus-rulings.md; hard date ~2026-10-02 for the first trial sync). Contract: one row per (provider workout id, LastModifiedDate); unchanged lm on re-fetch writes NOTHING (never a row per sync pass); a changed lm INSERTS a new versioned row; TTL purges rows STRICTLY older than 90 days by fetched_at, per row. CONVENTION the spec does not state: a row exactly 90.0 days old is RETAINED ('past 90 days' read as strictly-older); challengeable. Days are used as the unit in vectors; the sweep's real unit is the timestamp. Harness co-evolution: needs a repository-level arm (SQL or Dart repo test), not the transformer arm.
